diagnoses.label: hardcoded repo path and patch contract
diagnoses.observable_evidence: maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md hardcodes `cd /home/travis/build/failed/google/auto` and patch path `/home/travis/build/failed/google/auto/patch_1.diff`, while the task specifies the repository is at `/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>` and patch files must be `/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>/patch_{i}.diff`.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Any run where the benchmark provides a variable repo slug and id path rather than a fixed repository location
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Cases where the repository is guaranteed to be google/auto at a fixed path
diagnoses.target_section: Build-repair artifact contract; Minimal diagnostic sequence
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Replace hardcoded paths with a parameterized convention aligned to the task’s `/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>`; explicitly bind a REPO_DIR variable and derive patch/notes paths from it.

diagnoses.label: missing toolchain selection and reproducible build command convention
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Location hint requests checking “构建工具链选择、失败复现与构建命令的约定”, but maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md contains only a stub (artifact contract + `cd ...`), with no guidance on selecting Maven wrapper vs system Maven, Java version constraints, or a canonical reproduce command (e.g., `mvn -e -X ...` vs `./mvnw ...`).
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Maven CI repair workflows where build failures depend on Maven wrapper, Maven version, Java version, or specific flags/profiles used by CI
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Non-Maven builds or repositories where toolchain is irrelevant and a single default `mvn test` always reproduces
diagnoses.target_section: General Maven lifecycle reminders (currently empty) / new section near Minimal diagnostic sequence
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add a decision procedure: prefer `./mvnw` if present; otherwise use `mvn`; record `mvn -v`/`java -version`; define a standard reproduce command set (clean/test/verify with `-e` and optionally `-DskipTests` only when justified) and how to mirror CI profiles.

diagnoses.label: missing nested test project dependency resolution boundaries
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Location hint calls out “嵌套测试项目的依赖解析与修改范围”, but maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md provides no mechanism for handling Maven Invoker/IT projects (e.g., `src/it/**`, `maven-invoker-plugin`), including how to resolve their dependencies and what files are in-scope to modify vs fixtures to preserve.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Repositories using Maven Invoker or nested sample projects where build failures originate from IT fixture POMs, local repo resolution, or plugin configuration affecting nested builds
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Single-module projects without invoker/failsafe/IT fixture directories
diagnoses.target_section: General Maven lifecycle reminders / add dedicated 'Invoker & nested projects' section
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add guidance to detect invoker usage, locate nested project roots, reproduce invoker runs, and define modification scope rules (prefer fixing parent/plugin config; only edit IT fixture POMs when the failure is within the fixture and changes are minimal and justified).

diagnoses.label: artifact contract omits required diagnosis note file
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Task Step 1 requires writing analysis/plan to `/home/travis/build/failed/failed_reasons.txt`, but maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md’s artifact contract mentions only creating/applying a patch and checking git status; it does not mention producing the required diagnosis artifact at the specified path.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Benchmarks requiring both a diagnosis text artifact and patch diffs in specific filesystem locations
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Workflows that only require code changes without external artifact files
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Extend the contract to include creation/updating of `failed_reasons.txt` at the benchmark-specified path and tie it to the same parameterized repo/id binding used for patches.

overlay.composition_issue: Hardcoded paths (repo + patch) prevent correct artifact production and also block any added reproduction/toolchain guidance from being executable because commands would run in the wrong directory; missing diagnosis artifact requirement further breaks end-to-end compliance even if build fixes succeed.
preservation_constraints: Preserve existing general Maven reference content in other Skill files (dependency-management, plugin-configuration) as they are not implicated by the location hint
Preserve the requirement to produce a standard unified diff and to apply it, but make paths variable and benchmark-aligned

package_assessment.rationale: All observed failures are documentation/workflow-contract defects within maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md (path binding, artifact outputs, and missing procedural guidance). They can be corrected by editing the Skill bundle without needing external repository state.
